New Employee Onboarding Checklist

This checklist helps managers and new hires prepare for a smooth first month.

Day One

  • The laptop and accounts are provisioned before the first morning.
  • The new hire meets an onboarding buddy who answers everyday questions.

First Week

Every new employee completes the mandatory security awareness training within the first week and signs the code of conduct.

First Ninety Days

Managers review a 30-60-90 day plan with the new hire and hold a feedback conversation at the end of each period.
